item.title: Looking Up: Artist Angélique Ferrão Comes Face-to-Face With Black Austin Figures
item.description: In a sunlit gallery in historically Black East Austin, larger-than-life community leaders peer through vibrant canvas windows. Masterfully captured by self-taught painter Angélique Ferrão, the Black men featured in Ferrão’s inaugural art exhibit “Vis-à-Vis” invite you to meet them face-to-face.
